args: pkill rofi || true && rofi -show drun -modi drun,filebrowser,run,window
hyprctl keyword cursor:zoom_factor "$(hyprctl getoption cursor:zoom_factor | awk 'NR==1 {factor = $2; if (factor < 1) {factor = 1}; print factor * 2.0}')"
hyprctl keyword cursor:zoom_factor "$(hyprctl getoption cursor:zoom_factor | awk 'NR==1 {factor = $2; if (factor < 1) {factor = 1}; print factor / 2.0}')"
